name: ignite-rally
description: Ignite Rally. THE GAME NEEDS NO BUILD AND NO PACKAGES — index.html and the ES modules under src/ are served as they are, and that stays true. This manifest exists so the TEST HARNESS can be installed reproducibly: the suites drive a headless browser through playwright-core, and with nothing declaring that dependency a fresh checkout ran `node tests/validation.mjs` straight into ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on every suite. No `type` field on purpose: the suites rely on a bare .js file parsing in the script goal (see the parse check in tests/test-static.mjs), so declaring the package a module would change what that check measures.
